scope: Proposition 7.3 of the manuscript “Eventual categoricity for abstract elementary classes” (preprints/Eventual-Categoricity-for-Abstract-Elementary-Classes-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 240 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dcb7401285f5ac78), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 52. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a bound function h, depending only on the fixed working scheme, with the following property. Put σ = |u, c| + ℵ0. At sufficiently closed eligible levels, precisely one of the following alternatives holds for q = tp(u, c/A): 1. q is isolated relative to u by a fragment of size at most h(σ); 2. there are an extension A ≤ B at the same level and an extension qB of q such that qB ̸= qfr B, qB ↾ u = tp(u/A)fr B. In particular, every relatively isolated type has an isolating fragment bounded by h(σ), uniformly in the level and in the type.
